text: {"answer":"Ilse Marrenkamp","confidence":88,"independent_sources":5,"reasoning":"Five of six sources (Ledgerline, Northfold Observer, Meridian Brief, Harbour Dispatch, Signal & Stone) name Ilse Marrenkamp as chief executive appointed in March. The sources disagree on background details such as her prior employer, the predecessor, and the exact date (March 4 vs. 18), so I can't treat them as fully consistent, but the name itself is consistent."}
